subject: Re: Your quotation Q-20260815 - We'd like to proceed
body:
Dear Sales Team,

Thank you for the quotation. After internal review, we have decided to move forward.

Please prepare the Proforma Invoice for:
- Aluminum Composite Panel 4mm PVDF: 2,000 sqm
- Delivery: end of September

But before that, could you also advise if you can offer a better price for 3,000 sqm?

Best regards,
David Mueller
note: 混合意图：主体是下单（order），但末尾又问了一次价格（inquiry）。规则层会两边都命中，置信度低。

subject: URGENT - Request to postpone shipment for PO-2026-0871
body:
Hello,

Due to unforeseen circumstances at our warehouse, we need to postpone the shipment for PO-2026-0871 by 3 weeks.

This is not a complaint about your service - your team has been excellent. We simply need more time to prepare the receiving area.

Please advise if this is feasible and whether there will be any storage fees.

Best regards,
Lisa Wong
note: 含 URGENT + advise（投诉/询盘关键词），但明确写了 not a complaint。规则层极易误判为 complaint。

subject: Regarding the defective batch - What is your compensation policy?
body:
Dear Supplier,

We received the goods and found some issues with batch #BM-20260715.

Before we file a formal claim, we would like to understand your compensation policy. Could you please send us the relevant terms?

We value this partnership and hope to resolve this amicably.

Best regards,
Legal Department
note: 语气极其客气（value partnership / amicably），全是提问句式。规则层会当成 inquiry。

subject: When can we expect delivery for order #UK-5567?
body:
Hi there,

We placed order #UK-5567 three weeks ago and haven't received any shipping advice yet.

Could you please update us on the production status and expected delivery date?

Thanks,
Operations Team
note: 大量 order 关键词（order #、delivery），但真实意图是催问进度 = inquiry。规则层会判成 order。

subject: Payment sent - please confirm receipt
body:
Dear Team,

We have transferred the deposit of USD 6,615.00 today. Remittance reference: PO-2026-0871.

Please confirm receipt and advise when production will start.

Best regards,
Finance Dept.
note: 既有付款通知（notification），又有询问生产进度（inquiry）。主意图是告知已付款。

subject: Samples approved! Let's place the order
body:
Great news - our client loved the marble tile samples.

We would like to place an order for:
- MT-2024 White: 500 sqm
- MT-2024 Grey: 300 sqm

Please send the Proforma Invoice. Also, what is the lead time for 800 sqm?

Grazie!
Marco
note: 前半段是样品反馈（inquiry 语境），后半段是下单。规则层 sample/lead time 会拉高 inquiry 分。
